title: Cherokee–American wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Cherokee–American wars", at revision 1375454380, opens: "The Cherokee–American wars, also known as the Chickamauga Wars, were a series of raids, campaigns, ambushes, minor skirmishes, and several full-scale frontier battles in the Old Southwest from 1776 to 1794 between the Cherokee and American settlers on the frontier. Most of the events took place in the Upper South region. While the fighting stretched across the entire period, there were extended periods with little or no action." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4122685, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1776–1794 series of wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
